Microsoft Edge is about to lock out older ad blockers, just like Chrome did
item.description:
📝 ﻿Microsoft’s plan for Edge means that uBlock Origin users are losing one of their browser options. Anyone still using these extensions can switch to a different adblocker, like uBlock Origin Lite. Enterprise deprecation will follow in early 2027.
🔗 Read more: https://www.theverge.com/tech/976880/microsoft-edge-extensions-ad-blockers-mv2-mv3

item.title: Lost my phone at the office. Claude suggested tracking Bluetooth signal strength
item.description:
